## Penumbra — network detection overview
Alerts from Penumbra's two heads. **Penumbra never blocks**: every row carries `DvcAction = "Allow"`, however confident the model was. `ThreatConfidence` is the calibrated probability ×100; `Priority` is a sort key and **not** a probability; novelty is a percentile against known-benign traffic.

content.query:
PenumbraAlerts_CL
| extend Verdict = tostring(AdditionalFields.Verdict), Lane = tostring(AdditionalFields.Lane),
         Novelty = todouble(AdditionalFields.NoveltyPercentile), Suppression = tostring(AdditionalFields.SuppressionRuleId),
         Model = tostring(AdditionalFields.ModelVersion)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Lane, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Alerts by lane

content.query:
PenumbraAlerts_CL
| extend Verdict = tostring(AdditionalFields.Verdict), Lane = tostring(AdditionalFields.Lane),
         Novelty = todouble(AdditionalFields.NoveltyPercentile), Suppression = tostring(AdditionalFields.SuppressionRuleId),
         Model = tostring(AdditionalFields.ModelVersion)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Verdict | order by Alerts desc
content.title: Verdict mix (BENIGN_BY_POLICY = matched an expiring suppression rule)

content.query:
PenumbraAlerts_CL
| extend Verdict = tostring(AdditionalFields.Verdict), Lane = tostring(AdditionalFields.Lane),
         Novelty = todouble(AdditionalFields.NoveltyPercentile), Suppression = tostring(AdditionalFields.SuppressionRuleId),
         Model = tostring(AdditionalFields.ModelVersion)
| where Verdict == 'BENIGN_BY_POLICY'
| summarize Suppressed = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Suppression
| order by Suppressed desc
content.title: What was suppressed, by rule — suppression reclassifies, it never deletes

content.query:
PenumbraAlerts_CL
| extend Verdict = tostring(AdditionalFields.Verdict), Lane = tostring(AdditionalFields.Lane),
         Novelty = todouble(AdditionalFields.NoveltyPercentile), Suppression = tostring(AdditionalFields.SuppressionRuleId),
         Model = tostring(AdditionalFields.ModelVersion)
| where Lane == 'known_threat' and Verdict == 'KNOWN_ATTACK'
| summarize Alerts = count(), MaxConfidence = max(ThreatConfidence), Techniques = make_set(tostring(AdditionalFields.AttackTechnique), 5) by SrcIpAddr, ThreatCategory
| order by Alerts desc | take 20
content.title: Known-threat lane: top sources (pseudonymised)

content.query:
PenumbraAlerts_CL
| extend Verdict = tostring(AdditionalFields.Verdict), Lane = tostring(AdditionalFields.Lane),
         Novelty = todouble(AdditionalFields.NoveltyPercentile), Suppression = tostring(AdditionalFields.SuppressionRuleId),
         Model = tostring(AdditionalFields.ModelVersion)
| where Lane == 'hunting'
| top 50 by Novelty desc
| project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Novelty, DetectorAgreement = toint(AdditionalFields.DetectorAgreement), EventMessage
content.title: Hunting lane: the fixed daily budget, most unusual first (Precision@k, not FPR)

content.query:
PenumbraAlerts_CL
| extend Verdict = tostring(AdditionalFields.Verdict), Lane = tostring(AdditionalFields.Lane),
         Novelty = todouble(AdditionalFields.NoveltyPercentile), Suppression = tostring(AdditionalFields.SuppressionRuleId),
         Model = tostring(AdditionalFields.ModelVersion)
| summarize Flows = count(), Abstained = countif(Lane == 'review') by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
| extend AbstentionRate = todouble(Abstained) / Flows
| project TimeGenerated, AbstentionRate
content.title: Abstention rate — the label-free drift signal (rises when the model's calibration assumption breaks)

content.query:
PenumbraAlerts_CL
| extend Verdict = tostring(AdditionalFields.Verdict), Lane = tostring(AdditionalFields.Lane),
         Novelty = todouble(AdditionalFields.NoveltyPercentile), Suppression = tostring(AdditionalFields.SuppressionRuleId),
         Model = tostring(AdditionalFields.ModelVersion)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Model, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Alerts by model version — a promotion or rollback shows up here

content.query:
PenumbraAlerts_CL
| summarize Rows = count(), Blocking = countif(DvcAction != 'Allow')
content.title: ADR-0001 check: rows with any action other than Allow (must be 0)
